description:
For sale is my 996.2 GT3, very well modified for the track but can also be reverted to stock if you prefer. I have all the stock parts except for the wing/spoiler. Modifications do not have papers. I have all the invoices for maintenance under my ownership aswell as the Porsche maintenance book stamped. Car has 2 keys.
I am negotiable and will also entertain trade + cash. (Looking for E36/E46/964/Clio V6/other interesting cars)
